title: Mobility/Core Circuit
author: David L.
desc:
To be incorporated with a 3-day/week strength training program, either after workouts or on 2 of your rest days. 

Specifically designed for the Healthy Strength program, which can be found here: https://www.boostcamp.app/users/yRPvet-weights-for-loose-ligaments

ss.note: Use a loop band around ankles or knees. Stay in a half-squat.

Tempo: 3–1–3 (hold at full extension 1s)

Notes: Focus on keeping hips square, arm reaching long, glutes active.
Brace core, press back into floor, and move opposite limbs in control.
